item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Morning Video Frame Thumbnail

turns.text: Use a clear frame from my video to make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. Keep me recognisable and add “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. Pick the frame yourself; make it warm and upbeat.

item.tests: Tests extracting a usable frame from an attached video and composing it with readable text into a still thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Source and frame selection: Use talk-one.mp4; pick a clear frame yourself.
answer_sheet.Person: The woman speaking at the kitchen table in the attached video; keep her recognisable.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm and upbeat, with big text beside my face; colours and font are your call.

must_haves: The deliverable is one still image in 16:9, not a video.
The thumbnail visibly uses a frame from talk-one.mp4, retaining the woman's identity and source-frame appearance.
The woman's face is clear and unobstructed.
The headline reads exactly “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in large, legible letters beside her face.
The overall treatment looks warm and upbeat.

Then I can make the warm, upbeat 16:9 thumbnail, keeping you recognisable with **“MORNINGS MADE EASY”** in big letters beside your face.
dialog.why: It asks the user to upload a screenshot or provide a direct video URL and waits for that input before making the thumbnail.
dialog.user: Use talk-one.mp4 and pick a clear frame yourself.

dialog.agent:
I understand—you want me to choose the frame. Unfortunately, the available frame-extraction tool can’t read the stored path for **talk-one.mp4**, so I can’t inspect it or select a clear frame.

Please send a **direct download URL for the video**—no need to choose a frame yourself. I can then try extracting it and making the thumbnail as requested.
dialog.why: It asks the user to provide a direct download URL for the video and waits for that information to proceed.

dialog.agent:
I’ll choose the frame and layout, but I still can’t access frames from the attached video’s stored path. Please share a direct video download link, or upload a screenshot.

I’ll handle the rest: warm, upbeat styling, your recognisable face, and **“MORNINGS MADE EASY”** in large letters beside you on a 16:9 thumbnail.
dialog.why: It asks the user to provide a direct video download link or upload a screenshot, and waits for that input before proceeding.

turns.agent:
My choice: a smiling close-up on the left, with **MORNINGS MADE EASY** in bold cream lettering on the right against a warm golden background.

I haven’t made it yet because the frame tool can’t open the attached video’s stored path. A direct download link to **talk-one.mp4** would let me try choosing the frame myself.
